source_snapshot.procedure: Check power status via IPMI command: ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC IP> -U <BMC username> -P <BMC password> chassis power status
source_snapshot.criteria: Power status should be displayed correctly.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES proposes the broader `chassis status`, forces cipher 17, exposes the password in process arguments and returns raw output for user judgment.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE after resolving the canonical command, BMC/SUT identity, allowed enum, freshness, secret-safe credential handling and deterministic acceptance.

old_problem: The prior record correctly rejected success-by-exit-code and the broader DeepSeek command, but retained Engineering Decision Pending for command/schema, state correctness and runtime binding. The IPMI specification and pinned ipmitool implementation now provide the authoritative command and parser semantics; the exact target, expected pre-state and approved access profile are finite Project inputs.
disposition_reason: Retain the Master's narrow `chassis power status` coverage. A pinned ipmitool implementation sends standard Get Chassis Status (Chassis NetFn, command 0x01), reads Current Power State bit 0 and renders exactly `Chassis Power is on|off`. Correctness is established by immutable BMC-to-SUT binding, fresh command completion, exact enum parsing and agreement with the owner-declared current pre-state or an approved contemporaneous read-only reference; no power mutation or log clear is involved.
decision_basis: XLSX row 982, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 983 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 983 / variant 0ec7148b04e4c61a.
IPMI v2.0 section 28.2 defines Get Chassis Status and Current Power State bit 0 as 1=system power on and 0=system power off; this is standard behavior, not an OEM guess.

Pinned ipmitool source sends command 0x01, masks response byte 0 with bit 0 and prints `Chassis Power is on` or `Chassis Power is off`. The broader `chassis status` decodes additional fields and is not substituted for the Master's exact interface coverage.

A syntactically valid on/off token alone cannot prove it belongs to the intended SUT or matches the intended checkpoint. The Project must bind BMC/SUT identity and supply a declared pre-state or approved contemporaneous correlation rule; mismatch is FAIL, not an invitation to retry or reinterpret.

ED-03, ED-15, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve standard-versus-OEM boundaries, objective PASS/FAIL, evidence, case identity and per-case analysis; ED-33, ED-34, ED-36 and ED-38 permit parameterized read-only automation with protected credentials, readiness checks and no mutation/retry.

test_case.test_name: Read and validate the canonical IPMI chassis power status for the bound SUT
test_case.purpose: Verify that the exact BMC associated with the selected SUT returns a fresh, standard, machine-parseable chassis power state through the Master's canonical IPMI command without changing power or logs.
required_package: Immutable Project mapping of SUT asset/serial to BMC address/identity and the owner-declared expected current state (`on` or `off`) or an approved contemporaneous read-only correlation source
Pinned reviewed ipmitool build and parser matching the recorded implementation semantics, plus the reviewed revision of the source Script if used
Approved LANplus channel/cipher/privilege profile discovered for this BMC; cipher 17 must not be assumed solely from DeepSeek guidance
Secret-safe BMC credential provider that does not expose a password in command arguments, logs or retained evidence
Bounded timeout/freshness window, clock source, exact accepted output grammar and redaction/evidence destination
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY AUTOMATION ONLY; DO NOT RUN DURING REVIEW. Resolve and record the exact SUT/BMC mapping and expected checkpoint state. Through the approved secret provider invoke the pinned equivalent of `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BOUND_BMC> -U <BOUND_USER> chassis power status` once with the Project-approved channel/cipher and timeout; do not place the password in `-P` arguments. Require successful transport and completion, capture redacted raw output and timestamp, and parse exactly one pinned-version token equivalent to `Chassis Power is on` or `Chassis Power is off`. Compare it with the owner-declared current pre-state or approved contemporaneous read-only reference. Emit a structured result with target identity, state and freshness. Do not clear logs, issue any power-control command or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The bound BMC request completes within the approved freshness window and yields exactly one accepted state, `on` or `off`, matching the declared state/reference for the same SUT and checkpoint. Credentials are absent from process/evidence output, no write command occurs and retained evidence identifies the tool/parser versions and target.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target association, successful standard command completion, one fresh accepted on/off token, agreement with the approved expected state/reference and a no-write/no-clear audit. Nonzero completion, timeout, authentication/target mismatch, zero/multiple/unknown tokens, stale output, state disagreement, broader-command substitution, secret exposure or any mutation is FAIL. If target mapping, expected checkpoint or parser/access profile is absent, report NOT READY; do not keep the engineering semantics Pending and do not infer PASS from exit code alone.
safety_gate: Allow only the pinned read-only `chassis power status` operation; deny `on`, `off`, `cycle`, `reset`, `soft`, policy writes, log clear and arbitrary command composition.
Verify BMC certificate/host identity or approved management-network association and SUT asset mapping before the read.
Keep secrets out of command arguments, stdout/stderr and evidence; use only the approved credential transport.
Use one bounded attempt. On timeout, ambiguous output or disagreement, preserve evidence and stop without automatic retry or power action.
Do not infer AC presence, PSU health, POST/OS readiness, application/workload health or transition capability from this one BMC state bit.
expected_evidence: SUT asset/serial and BMC endpoint/identity binding, approved channel/cipher profile and expected checkpoint/reference
Pinned ipmitool/parser/Script versions, invocation timestamp, timeout and redacted completion metadata
Redacted raw canonical output and exactly one parsed on/off state with freshness result
Expected-state or approved contemporaneous correlation result for the same SUT
No-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and automated PASS/FAIL/NOT READY result
test_case.recovery: No DUT state should change. On query failure or mismatch, terminate the session, retain redacted diagnostics and leave power/logs untouched. If credential material escaped, revoke/rotate it using the Project incident procedure. Correct only the mapping, access profile or parser under owner control before a separately initiated rerun; never use a power action as recovery.

source_conflict.reason: The Master unambiguously requires `chassis power status`. DeepSeek's broader `chassis status` is rejected review guidance, not a competing formal requirement.

blocked.reason: IPMI and the pinned ipmitool implementation define the read and on/off decoding. Exact target, credential transport, access profile, expected checkpoint and freshness are bounded Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact SUT/BMC mapping; approved channel/cipher/privilege; secret provider; pinned tool/parser/Script; expected current state or correlation source; timeout/freshness and evidence path.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Section 28.2 defines Get Chassis Status and Current Power State bit 0 as the system power on/off indication.

external_authorities.title: ipmitool pinned ipmi_chassis.c
external_authorities.application: The pinned implementation sends Chassis command 0x01, tests response byte 0 bit 0 and prints `Chassis Power is on|off`; it also distinguishes the broader chassis-status renderer.

external_authorities.title: ipmitool command manual
external_authorities.application: Documents `chassis status` as broad status and `chassis power status` as the narrow power subcommand, supporting exact Master-command preservation.

project_authority: The Project owner supplies the immutable BMC/SUT map, expected checkpoint or approved correlation, supported cipher/privilege, secret transport, pinned parser and freshness policy. These are runtime bindings and do not require a new engineering decision about standard power-state semantics.
